sources.entry: TablePro - Native macOS database client for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, and 15+ more.

summary.one_liner: TablePro is a free, open-source, native database client for macOS and iOS that connects to major SQL and NoSQL databases through native drivers.
summary.what_it_does: TablePro is a database client built with native frameworks rather than Electron or JDBC. It provides an SQL editor with autocomplete, multi-cursor and Vim mode, plus a data grid with inline editing, sorting, filtering and undo/redo. It supports native window tabs, multiple windows and split panes, SSH tunnels (password or key auth) and SSL/TLS, and keeps full-text searchable query history. It includes built-in AI features (chat, inline suggestions, Explain/Optimize) and an MCP server and URL scheme for tools like Cursor, Raycast and Claude Desktop, with support for your own API key or local Ollama. A plugin system lets users write database drivers in Swift, and plugin drivers install on demand from a registry.
use_cases: Browse and edit data in a MySQL or PostgreSQL database on a Mac
Query MongoDB, Redis or SQLite from a native macOS app
Connect to a remote database through an SSH tunnel
Write and optimize SQL with AI assistance
Let AI coding tools or Claude Desktop query local databases via MCP
Use a lightweight database client instead of an Electron or JVM tool
how_to_run: Or download the app from GitHub Releases
To build from source: brew install xcodegen, then cd apple, scripts/download-libs.sh, scripts/generate-project.sh
Build with xcodebuild using -scheme TablePro and CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
stack: Meson and Cargo (Linux app, in development)
notable: Native Swift app with no Electron, JDBC or JavaScript runtime
Supports multiple SQL and NoSQL engines via native drivers, with plugin drivers installed on demand
Built-in AI chat and inline suggestions, with bring-your-own key or local Ollama
MCP server and URL scheme for Cursor, Raycast and Claude Desktop
Core features free with no trial or time limit; paid license adds Mac features
caveats: macOS 13+ and iOS/iPadOS 18+ only; Linux (GNOME 50+) is in development and not released; no Windows support
Building from source requires Xcode 26 or later and XcodeGen
Starter and Team license tiers unlock extra Mac features such as iCloud Sync and Team Catalog
